Package mayhemlib.follow

Class HolonomicFollower

java.lang.Object
mayhemlib.follow.HolonomicFollower
public final class HolonomicFollower extends Object
Feedforward + saturated proportional feedback. The feedback is clamped so that a large error (e.g. after a bump) never produces a lurch beyond what the drivetrain can do.
